en: A black‑and‑white street scene lined with birch trees and wooden buildings. Vintage cars and several cyclists travel along a quiet avenue. There are shopfronts on the right, one with a sign reading "FRISÖR". Printed caption text at the lower left reads "Umeå. Skolgatan." and at the lower right is publishing information and a number. The overall style resembles a mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.
